items.subject: Pete, here's your handy car insurance renewal reminder
items.summary: Go.Compare says the car-insurance renewal date previously supplied is three days away and shows a saved cheapest annual quote of £742.88; the current policy expiry date should be verified before buying.
items.action: Check the current policy's expiry date directly and, if cover ends in three days, compare the renewal offer with the £742.88 saved quote and arrange uninterrupted cover before 20 September 2026.
items.decisionNeeded: Whether to renew the existing policy or purchase alternative car-insurance cover before the current policy expires.
